property_summary: After C is initialized through a proxy with a supplied access-control contract that grants every caller access, any caller's access-controlled call (setLimits) must succeed; the mutant stores address(0) as the access control so checkAccess targets an empty address and the call always reverts.
change_summary: Pass address(0) as the access control address instead of the supplied _accessControl argument, so checkAccess always queries the zero address and access-controlled calls behave differently.
